fact: The World Bank paper states that STEP-KIN beneficiaries in Kinshasa applied through a call centre or self-registration platform and the Fonds social validated them against whitelists and eligible neighbourhoods, enrolling 300,829 (95% of 315,000 applicants).

The World Bank paper states that mobile network operators paid STEP-KIN transfers into beneficiaries' mobile money accounts on the Fonds social's instructions, with 100% of enrolled beneficiaries paid successfully from March 2021.
